description: Search original, dated statistics published by Rendered Fits: how Shopify fashion stores publish size charts and fit notes, what AI shopping assistants receive about sizing, what a UK size 12 measures across retailers, and which AI crawlers fashion sites allow. Each result has the figure, its sample and date, the source page, a DOI where one exists and a ready-to-use citation. Empty query returns all.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "size chart image", "size 12 hips", "GPTBot", "fit notes".

name: search_fashion_statistics
title: Search original fashion sizing statistics
